parties:
Alauddin (Md) and others ----- Petitioners.
Vs.
Yusuf Ali and another ----- Opposite Parties.
full_judgment: 12. I have examined a copy of the kabala dated 28.4.81, Annexure' 'A' and a copy of the plaint which have been placed before me by the learned Advocate for the petitioner and it appears that in the schedules of both the documents the total area of land i.e. '63 decimals has been shown as ejmali property but the part of it that has been purchased by the plaintiff has not been specified. It appears from the record that the possession of only plot No. 208 of Khatian No. 218 has been transferred to the plaintiff through a receiver in Miscellaneous Case No. 915 of 80 but the injunction is prayed regarding three plots, which are 208, 88 and 89 of the same Khatian 210. Even in the judgments and' orders of the courts below, the disputed land has not been specified, and without specifying the land, possession of the plaintiff on the disputed land cannot be established and if the possession is not established no injunction can be granted. In this connection the case of Sirajul Islam vs. Mizanur Rahman reported in 29 DLR (SC) 82 may be cited here.
